question: Which Five-Year Plan was formulated by governments of two political parties?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sixth Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sixth Five-Year Plan** (1980-1985) was implemented during a time when there was a shift in political power in India.
 
• It was formulated under the government led by **Janata Party**, but later, when the Congress Party came back to power in 1980 under **Indira Gandhi**, they revised and reimplemented the plan.
 
• The plan focused on **poverty alleviation**, **economic modernization**, and an emphasis on reducing **regional disparities**.
 
• It introduced key policies to improve the **agriculture sector**, expand **employment opportunities**, and boost **industrial growth**.
 
• It also aimed to improve the **standard of living** of people and reduce inequalities in income and wealth.
 
• The Sixth Plan gave special focus to achieving **self-reliance** in technology and reducing dependence on imports.
 
• This plan was significant because it reflected the influence of two political ideologies and their approach to addressing economic challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eighth Five-Year Plan**__

 __
 
• The **Eighth Five-Year Plan** (1992-1997) prioritized the **economic liberalization** policies introduced in India during the early 1990s.
 
• It aimed at achieving **high economic growth** and focused on improvements in **human development indicators**, like health and education.
 
• This plan marked the beginning of **market-oriented reforms** in India.
 
 
 
• **Fifth Five-Year Plan**__
 __
 
• The **Fifth Five-Year Plan** (1974-1978) emphasized **poverty eradication** and achieving self-reliance in food production.
 
• It introduced the concept of **"Minimum Needs Programme"** to ensure the provision of basic services such as health, education, and rural infrastructure.
 
• This plan faced implementation challenges due to political instability and was terminated before completion.
 
 
 
• **Ninth Five-Year Plan**__
 
 
• The **Ninth Five-Year Plan** (1997-2002) focused on **sustainable development** and aimed to reduce **poverty** and increase **employment opportunities**.
 
• It emphasized the **growth of agriculture** and rural economy while addressing **social justice**.
 
• This plan sought to ensure the equitable distribution of resources and promote the welfare of marginalized sections of society.
